item.title: Vega Casts Lone Vote Against Police Pay Deal
item.description: Prince William County Supervisor Yesli Vega cast the lone vote against a newly approved police pay agreement, raising concerns about data, fiscal risk, and the county’s use of collective bargaining.

item.title: Townhouse Fire Displaces 5 near Manassas
item.description: Fire crews responded late Friday morning to reports of a townhouse on fire in the 10900 block of Hiram Court in Manassas, according to a fire department release.

item.title: Boil Water Advisories Expand Across County
item.description: Some Prince William County residents remain under a boil water advisory following a water supply disruption that affected two neighborhoods.

item.title: Recount Delays Woodbridge Democratic Caucus
item.description: Sources familiar with the vote say Muhammed “Sef” Casim narrowly defeated Pamela G. Montgomery in Saturday’s Democratic caucus to select a nominee for the Woodbridge District seat on the Prince William County Board of Supervisors.

item.title: Woodbridge Caucus Recount, Water Advisory, Monks March Through Region
item.description: A lot happened across Prince William County and the surrounding region this weekend, and we break it all down in this Sunday news update.

item.title: Bitter Cold Gives Way to Warmup
item.description: Bitter Cold Gives Way to Warmup

item.title: Manassas to Reconsider DMV Redevelopment
item.description: Manassas City Council will revisit a proposal to sell the former DMV property for a housing development when it meets Monday night, following a weather-related postponement last month.

item.title: Monks Walk Through Prince William County
item.description: The March for Peace, led by Buddhist monks walking from Texas to Washington, D.C., passed through Prince William County over the weekend, drawing large crowds despite bitterly cold temperatures.

item.title: Power Outage Hits Large Area Of Manassas
item.description: A widespread power outage affected a large residential section of Manassas on Sunday afternoon, leaving more than 1,800 customers without electricity as temperatures hovered in the mid-20s.

item.title: Prince William Water Lifts Boil Advisory
item.description: A boil water advisory affecting two Prince William County neighborhoods was lifted Sunday afternoon, while a separate advisory in another part of the county remains in effect.
